newsitem.title: USA: Ryland Group cuts div to $0.04 from $0.15.
newsitem.headline: Ryland Group cuts div to $0.04 from $0.15.

text.p: The Ryland Group Inc said Wednesday that it has cut its quarterly cash dividend to $0.04 per share, from $0.15 per share. The company said that the dividend cut more closely aligns Ryland's dividend yield with that of other public homebuilders.
The new dividend is payable July 30 to shareholders of record, July 15.

The company also said that it will repurchase of up to ten percent of its outstanding common shares, effective immediately. The company's purchases will be made in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions, from time to time, subject to market conditions. Ryland currently has approximately 16 million shares outstanding.
The company said that the combination of the repurchase program and change in dividend policy should result in a more efficient capital structure and a lower cost of capital.

The share repurchase program, which will be funded through a combination of the dividend reduction and internally generated funds, is not expected to have a material impact on the company's leverage or balance sheet, said the company.
Ryland is a mortgage company and homebuilder operating in 20 states.
